about_the_game:
Step into the streets of Rabat in Hood Tales Part 1: Morocco. Follow the journey of a young artist trying to escape the hood through music, only to get entangled in the crime world. Experience an untold side of Moroccan society in a vibrant, stylized world full of challenges and choices.

This open-world brings a fresh perspective to urban life in Morocco, shedding light on struggles, dreams, and the harsh realities of the streets. As you rise through the ranks, you’ll have to make tough decisions—stick to your music or give in to the temptations of crime. Every choice shapes your path in a world where survival isn’t guaranteed.

With its innovative art style and colorful environments, Hood Tales Part 1: Morocco blends a unique visual identity with immersive gameplay. Explore the city, hustle to survive, and carve out your destiny in a world that’s as stylish as it is unforgiving. Will you escape the cycle, or will the streets pull you in? The choice is yours.

  • OS: macOS 10.13 (High Sierra)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (2.5 GHz) or Apple M1
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Plus Graphics 640 / AMD Radeon R9 M370X
  • Storage: 12 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12 (Monterey) or later
  • Processor: Apple M1/M2 or Intel Core i7 (3.2 GHz)
  • Memory: 6 MB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon Pro 5500M / Apple M1/M2 GPU
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated
